summary: Leeds Bradford airspace control zone and aerodrome zone deactivated as the airport is closed, with air traffic services unavailable.
text:
LEEDS BRADFORD CTA, CTR, ATZ DEACTIVATED, AD CLSD. ATC SER NOT 
AVBL. SUITABLY EQUIPPED ACFT SHOULD MONITOR LEEDS RADAR ON CH134.580 
AND SQUAWK EITHER 2677, ANY DISCRETE TASK SPECIFIC CODE, OR ANY 
DISCRETE CODE ALLOCATED BY ANOTHER UNIT. MET OBSERVATIONS UNVERIFIED 
DURING PERIODS OF CLOSURE.
